name: Kaunas University of Technology
summary: Technical university in Kaunas; 26 English-taught bachelor's and integrated degrees in engineering, informatics, sciences and business.

ib.text: KTU scores your IB grades: maths or a programme subject, a second subject and English, each above 60%. English needs B2 (IELTS 5.5 or equivalent). Finishing the IB adds 0.5 bonus points.

programmes.name: Applied Chemistry
programmes.about: Chemistry for new products from cosmetics to pharmaceuticals and functional materials, with laboratory practice in synthesising and testing new materials.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is chemistry 40%, a second subject 40% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%.

programmes.name: Biomedical Materials Industries
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Technological and Physical Sciences
programmes.about: Chemistry, biology and engineering combined to develop materials and medical devices for medicine.

needs.note: Second subject, 40%: one of these (or engineering technologies)

programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, a second subject 40% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%. Fee-paying; state-funded via LAMA BPO.

programmes.name: Chemical Technology and Engineering
programmes.about: Chemical engineering beyond theory: creating new materials, controlling processes and solving industrial problems.

needs.note: Second subject, 40%: one of these (or engineering technologies)

programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, a second subject 40% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%. Fee-paying; state-funded via LAMA BPO.

programmes.name: Food Science and Technology
programmes.about: Food chemistry, microbiology, nutrition and technology for food safety, quality and sustainability.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, a second subject 40% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%. Fee-paying; state-funded via LAMA BPO.

programmes.name: Industrial Biotechnology
programmes.about: Biotechnological processes, molecular biology, genetic engineering, bioinformatics and bioprocess engineering to make bioproducts for industry.

needs.note: Second subject, 40%: one of these (or engineering technologies)

programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, a second subject 40% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%. Fee-paying; state-funded via LAMA BPO.

programmes.name: Architecture
programmes.about: Integrated five-year degree in designing buildings and urban space, with practical projects alongside civil engineering students; qualifies you to practise as an architect across the EU.
programmes.selectionNote: A digital portfolio of up to 8 projects, then a remote artistic entrance exam (three sittings in 2026) for selected applicants; 2026 procedure, 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: Judged on a portfolio, a remote drawing entrance exam and maybe an interview; maths, IT or physics and English from your IB grades also count.

programmes.name: Automation and Control
programmes.about: Designing automation from machine control to intelligent systems, robotics and AI.

needs.note: Second subject, 40%: one of these (or engineering technologies)

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering
programmes.about: Electrical machines, power electronics and energy converters, with design and operation of power and energy systems.

needs.note: Second subject, 40%: one of these (or engineering technologies)

programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, a second subject 40% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%. Fee-paying; state-funded via LAMA BPO.

separateFrom.name: Electronics and Electrical Engineering
separateFrom.reason: Different programme: a 3-year English-only degree combining electronics and electrical engineering; this one is 4 years and focused on power and energy systems.

programmes.name: Electronics and Electrical Engineering
programmes.about: Electronics and electrical engineering in one three-year programme, for developing advanced and safe electronic and electrical systems; English only.

needs.note: Second subject, 40%: one of these (or engineering technologies)

programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, a second subject 40% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%. Fee-paying; state-funded via LAMA BPO.

separateFrom.name: Electrical Engineering
separateFrom.reason: Different programme: a 4-year degree focused on power and energy systems; this one is 3 years, English only, and covers electronics as well.

programmes.name: Renewable Energy Engineering
programmes.about: Solar, wind, hydro and biofuel technologies and how to apply them in energy production and use, with hands-on laboratory training.

needs.note: Second subject, 40%: one of these (or engineering technologies)

programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, a second subject 40% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%. Fee-paying; state-funded via LAMA BPO.

programmes.name: Robotics
programmes.about: Designing, programming and training robots for homes, space or industry, with computer science, electronics and control.

programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, a second subject 40% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%. Fee-paying; state-funded via LAMA BPO.

programmes.name: Transport Electronics
programmes.about: Electronics for electric and autonomous vehicles and intelligent transport: design, diagnostics and engine management technologies. Also offered part-time over six years.

programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, a second subject 40% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%. Fee-paying; state-funded via LAMA BPO.

programmes.name: Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Building intelligent software with machine learning, image recognition and data analysis, applied to business, academic and public-sector problems.
programmes.selectionNote: Half the score is a maths entry exam, 30% a second subject and 20% English; each entry subject above 60%.

programmes.name: Informatics
programmes.about: Programming, 3D models, cloud and mobile networks, web solutions and multimedia, with internet informatics and multimedia systems paths.
programmes.selectionNote: Half the score is a maths entry exam, 30% a second subject and 20% English; each entry subject above 60%.

programmes.name: Engineering Physics
programmes.about: Physics with AI and measurement solutions: micro- and nanoelectronics, nanotechnology, advanced materials, IoT and photonics.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is physics 40%, a second subject 20% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%.

programmes.name: Materials Physics and Nanotechnologies

programmes.name: Aviation Engineering

programmes.name: Fashion Engineering
programmes.about: Digital design technologies, advanced textiles and sustainable, functional clothing for people interested in fashion and technology.

needs.note: Second subject, 40%: one of these (or engineering technologies)

programmes.name: Industrial Engineering
programmes.about: Optimising production, developing prototypes, robotic solutions and digital manufacturing, plus management skills.

needs.note: Second subject, 40%: one of these (or engineering technologies)

programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, a second subject 40% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%. Fee-paying; state-funded via LAMA BPO.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: Designing manufacturing systems, machines, vehicles and intelligent technologies, with four pathways to choose from.

programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, a second subject 40% and English 20%, from your IB grades; each entry subject above 60%. Fee-paying; state-funded via LAMA BPO.

needs.note: Second subject, 40%: one of these (or engineering technologies)

programmes.name: Communication Studies and Information Management Technologies
programmes.about: Content creation and technological solutions for communication in global business and public-sector projects.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is English 40%, a second subject 40% and an oral motivation assessment 20%; each entry subject above 60%.

programmes.name: New Media Language
programmes.about: English-language programme for managing projects and writing copy for news portals, websites, social media, advertising and entertainment, with an international teaching team.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is English 50%, a second subject 30% and an oral motivation assessment 20%; each entry subject above 60%.

programmes.name: Public Policy and Administration
programmes.about: New programme on public policy and administration: analysing societal challenges and making evidence-based decisions at national and international level. Needs ministry approval.
programmes.ib: New programme, subject to approval by the Ministry of Education, Science and Sport; 2027 criteria not yet published.
programmes.selectionNote: Entry subjects and weights are not published yet. KTU ranks on school grades in the entry subjects, each above 60%. Starts only with ministry approval.

programmes.name: Business Digitalization Management
programmes.about: Bringing AI, robotics, big data, virtual reality and IoT into business processes, for careers as digitalisation managers.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths or economics 40%, a second subject 40% and an oral motivation assessment 20%; each entry subject above 60%.

programmes.name: Economics
programmes.about: Economics and analytics: how societies, governments and businesses decide, with data analysis and BA+ competence blocks to choose from.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths or economics 40%, a second subject 40% and an oral motivation assessment 20%; each entry subject above 60%.

notes: KTU's own admission takes foreign citizens only into fee-paying places; an EU citizen can also apply through LAMA BPO for a state-funded place in an English programme (write to international@ktu.lt).
Yearly fee 2026/27 by field: €3,250 (business, economics, communication, linguistics), €4,201 (engineering, technology, informatics, sciences), €5,676 for the first 240 credits of Architecture.
Each entry subject needs an average above 60%, and programme pages allow at most three years since leaving school.
